instruction:
You are a mechanical/life-safety engineer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-08 smoke control, visibility, and egress interaction package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. External smoke-control, visibility, egress, alarm load, and battery-runtime workflows shape the practice context only; they are not extra data sources for this instance.

## Scene

- Product family: `SSC-08-LH-05`
- Fire strategy: `FIRE-08-STRATEGY-05`
- Population schedule: `POP-08-SCHED-05`
- Ventilation schedule: `VENT-08-SCHED-05`
- Egress plan: `EGRESS-08-PLAN-05`
- Visibility criterion: `VIS-08-CRIT-05`
- Tenability memo: `MEMO-08-TENABILITY-05`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Fire zone volume | {{ fire_zone_volume_m3 }} m3 |
| Smoke exhaust flow | {{ smoke_exhaust_flow_m3_h }} m3/h |
| Required air changes | {{ required_air_changes_per_h }} 1/h |
| Smoke layer height | {{ smoke_layer_height_m }} m |
| Minimum smoke layer height | {{ minimum_smoke_layer_height_m }} m |
| Visibility | {{ visibility_m }} m |
| Required visibility | {{ required_visibility_m }} m |
| Population | {{ population_persons }} persons |
| Egress width factor | {{ egress_width_factor_mm_per_person }} mm/person |
| Provided egress width | {{ provided_egress_width_mm }} mm |
| Egress flow rate | {{ egress_flow_rate_person_m_s }} persons/(m*s) |
| Maximum egress time | {{ max_egress_time_s }} s |
| Ventilation load | {{ ventilation_load_kw }} kW |
| Alarm load | {{ alarm_load_kw }} kW |
| Battery capacity | {{ battery_capacity_kwh }} kWh |
| Battery usable fraction | {{ battery_usable_fraction }} |
| Required runtime | {{ required_runtime_h }} h |

## Checks

- Smoke exhaust air changes per hour equal smoke exhaust flow divided by fire zone volume.
- ACH margin equals exhaust ACH minus required ACH.
- Smoke layer height margin equals smoke layer height minus minimum smoke layer height.
- Visibility margin equals visibility minus required visibility.
- Required egress width equals population times egress width factor.
- Egress flow time equals population divided by provided width and egress flow rate.
- Battery margin equals usable battery capacity minus ventilation and alarm load energy for the required runtime.
- Overall pass score is `1.0` only when smoke, visibility, egress, and battery checks pass; otherwise it is `0.0`.

## Output Format

Write a compact tenability memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Preserve the object IDs above and state whether the baseline source pack passes the current docs-only checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "smoke_exhaust_air_changes_per_h": <numeric_value>,
  "ach_margin": <numeric_value>,
  "smoke_layer_height_margin_m": <numeric_value>,
  "visibility_margin_m": <numeric_value>,
  "required_egress_width_mm": <numeric_value>,
  "egress_width_margin_mm": <numeric_value>,
  "egress_flow_time_s": <numeric_value>,
  "egress_time_margin_s": <numeric_value>,
  "life_safety_battery_margin_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```
paramsToml:
[meta]
name = "smoke-control-visibility-egress-interaction-package"
description = "SSC-08 smoke control, visibility, and egress interaction metrics"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound tenability interaction metrics from a deterministic SSC-08 task-owned source pack. The template combines smoke exhaust ACH, smoke layer height, visibility, egress width/time, life-safety battery margin, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "mechanical"
category = "smoke-control-egress"
standards = ["smoke control workflow", "visibility criterion review", "egress width review", "life-safety battery review"]
tags = ["mechanical", "building", "smoke-control", "visibility", "egress", "life-safety", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.fire_zone_volume_m3]
type = "float"
unit = "m3"
description = "FIRE-08-STRATEGY-05 fire zone volume"
min = 4200.0
max = 4200.0

[params.smoke_exhaust_flow_m3_h]
type = "float"
unit = "m3/h"
description = "VENT-08-SCHED-05 smoke exhaust flow"
min = 31500.0
max = 31500.0

[params.required_air_changes_per_h]
type = "float"
unit = "1/h"
description = "VIS-08-CRIT-05 required air changes"
min = 6.0
max = 6.0

[params.smoke_layer_height_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "FIRE-08-STRATEGY-05 smoke layer height"
min = 2.4
max = 2.4

[params.minimum_smoke_layer_height_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "VIS-08-CRIT-05 minimum smoke layer height"
min = 2.1
max = 2.1

[params.visibility_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "VIS-08-CRIT-05 visibility"
min = 14.0
max = 14.0

[params.required_visibility_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "VIS-08-CRIT-05 required visibility"
min = 10.0
max = 10.0

[params.population_persons]
type = "float"
unit = "persons"
description = "POP-08-SCHED-05 population"
min = 520.0
max = 520.0

[params.egress_width_factor_mm_per_person]
type = "float"
unit = "mm/person"
description = "EGRESS-08-PLAN-05 egress width factor"
min = 5.0
max = 5.0

[params.provided_egress_width_mm]
type = "float"
unit = "mm"
description = "EGRESS-08-PLAN-05 provided egress width"
min = 3200.0
max = 3200.0

[params.egress_flow_rate_person_m_s]
type = "float"
unit = "persons/(m*s)"
description = "EGRESS-08-PLAN-05 egress flow rate"
min = 1.25
max = 1.25

[params.max_egress_time_s]
type = "float"
unit = "s"
description = "EGRESS-08-PLAN-05 maximum egress time"
min = 180.0
max = 180.0

[params.ventilation_load_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "VENT-08-SCHED-05 ventilation load"
min = 12.5
max = 12.5

[params.alarm_load_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "FIRE-08-STRATEGY-05 alarm load"
min = 2.2
max = 2.2

[params.battery_capacity_kwh]
type = "float"
unit = "kWh"
description = "VENT-08-SCHED-05 battery capacity"
min = 36.0
max = 36.0

[params.battery_usable_fraction]
type = "float"
description = "VENT-08-SCHED-05 battery usable fraction"
min = 0.85
max = 0.85

[params.required_runtime_h]
type = "float"
unit = "h"
description = "MEMO-08-TENABILITY-05 required runtime"
min = 2.0
max = 2.0

[outputs.smoke_exhaust_air_changes_per_h]
description = "Smoke exhaust air changes per hour"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.ach_margin]
description = "Smoke exhaust ACH minus required ACH"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.smoke_layer_height_margin_m]
description = "Smoke layer height margin"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.visibility_margin_m]
description = "Visibility margin"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.required_egress_width_mm]
description = "Required egress width"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.egress_width_margin_mm]
description = "Provided egress width minus required width"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.egress_flow_time_s]
description = "Egress flow time"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.egress_time_margin_s]
description = "Maximum egress time minus flow time"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.life_safety_battery_margin_kwh]
description = "Usable battery capacity minus required life-safety load energy"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when smoke-control and egress checks pass"
tolerance = 0.001

[archetypes.ssc08_smoke_egress_case]
description = "Smoke control, visibility, and egress interaction case"
site_contexts = ["ssc08-smoke-egress"]

[difficulty.easy]
description = "All source-pack values given for the SSC-08 smoke-control package"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["ssc08_smoke_egress_case"]

[difficulty.medium]

visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["ssc08_smoke_egress_case"]
